meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: Transform data into compelling narratives using visualization, context, and persuasive structure. Use when presenting analytics to stakeholders, creating data reports, or building executive presentations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把数据变成有说服力的故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常需要向别人解释数据背后的含义
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain the meaning behind data to others

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你的数据组织成有情节的叙事：先给出关键洞察，再补充背景、问题和解决方案，最终落到行动建议；还会提供图表标注、对比、渐进展示等可视化思路，以及高管汇报、故事流程、单页仪表盘等现成模板。
howto.when: 当你要求做数据分析汇报、季度业务复盘或投资者演示等数据呈现场景时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这份季度销售数据讲成故事。
say.note: Claude 会按叙事结构产出带洞察和建议的汇报。

say.text: 用“问题-解决方案”框架分析客户流失数据。
say.note: 它会套用该框架组织内容。

say.text: 给这个图表写标注，突出产品发布后的增长。
say.note: Claude 会给出图表标注和强调建议。

howto.what_en: Claude turns your data into a narrative: leads with insight, adds context/problem/solution, ends with action. It suggests visualization techniques (annotations, comparisons, progressive reveal) and offers templates for exec summaries, story flows, dashboard stories.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for analytics presentations to stakeholders, quarterly business reviews, or investor presentations, and similar data-reporting scenarios.

say_en.text: Turn this quarterly sales data into a story.
say_en.note: Claude will structure it as a narrative with insights and actions.

say_en.text: Analyze customer churn using the problem-solution framework.
Annotate this chart to highlight the post-launch spike.
